title: A sharp collapsed-fibre likelihood classification for a four-visible restricted Boltzmann machine
current_formal_scope: Lean 4.33.1 checked the 15-source closure and all three selected declarations sharp_parity_classification, collapsed_local_max_iff and nonstable_parameter_saddle, using only standard kernel axioms. The result covers exactly four visible spins, one hidden unit and pure four-parity data, including the equality boundary. Broader RBMs, optimization-time claims and training convergence are outside this verification. Pinned sources and audit records are supplied in the companion repository.
